0x65b378 reads response features+5; 0x65b384 stores nfc_cb+0xc4. Independent stock size getter 0x65b218 reads same offset.

native_read_only_checks: Full preflight precedes version read; version==0x20 precedes remaining cached RAM reads.
Preflight checks are reads only; active foreign or own HAL hook causes unavailable.
nfc_probe_info calls no install/restore, discovery, command, response, or route mutation APIs.
Info formatting uses a separate bounded static buffer and preserves g.diagnostic and retained status.
CONTROL03 module branch requires no desired/active/cleanup state, returns INFO response, and does not enter START or STOP branch.
Cached wording accurately describes startup cache rather than a fresh controller query.

checks: Independent InfoRequest object; INFO cannot establish or replace QUERY verification.

INFO timeout/completion retain sequence and consume late replies; disconnect resets identity.
INFO is blocked during QUERY/START/STOP/reader/transceive; START is blocked while INFO pending.
CONTROL payload03 only; confirmInfo changes display/state of INFO request, never enables ReaderMode.
